build_BertConfig: build a BertConfig from a JSON file or vocabulary size with custom hidden size and attention heads
create_BertModel: create a BERT model with model parallel embeddings and encoder layers for sequence encoding
run_BertForPreTraining: run BERT pre-training with masked language modeling and next sentence prediction heads
test_BertForSequenceClassification: test BERT sequence classification by passing input tokens and labels to get classification logits
load_BertForQuestionAnswering: load a BERT question answering model and predict start and end logits for span extraction
